tour.welcome.title: Hello! 👋
tour.welcome.text:
Welcome to TopLista.mk!

Would you like a quick tour of the site? It takes about 2 minutes and will show you what the site offers — charts, artists, events, and much more.

You can also start it later from ⚙ Settings.
tour.step0.title: Hello! 👋
tour.step0.text:
Welcome to TopLista.mk!

This is a site for anyone who loves Macedonian music — we track artists, rank songs, collect events and news, and much more.

Let's see what the site has to offer. The tour takes about 2 minutes.
tour.step1.title: Navigation
tour.step1.text:
This is the navigation. From here you can reach everything: charts, master list, events, news, and more.

On mobile, tap the logo in the top left to open the menu — there's also a "Home" button for quick access to the main page.
tour.step2.title: Settings ⚙
tour.step2.text:
In settings you can change a few things:

• Theme — light or dark, whatever you prefer
• Streaming service — choose yours (Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music…)

When you click a song on the site, it will open directly in the service you chose.

⚙ Settings are in the top bar — just scroll up to find them next to the logo.
tour.step3.title: Home page 🏠
tour.step3.text:
This is the dashboard — an overview of everything happening on the site.

Here you can see the most played songs, new releases, upcoming events, news, curator picks, and more — all in one place.
tour.step4.title: Quick actions ⚡
tour.step4.text:
These buttons are shortcuts to the most useful features:

• Surprise me — random artist
• Add artist — suggest someone who's missing
• Add event — report a concert or festival
• Become a curator — share your playlist

Just one click.
tour.step5.title: Charts 📊
tour.step5.text:
This is the heart of the site — the Charts.

Here the most listened releases (songs, albums, EPs) by Macedonian artists are ranked. Ranking is based on Spotify play counts.

Data is refreshed daily, and a new chart is calculated every Monday. Every past chart is saved in the archive.
tour.step6.title: Filters
tour.step6.text:
There isn't just one chart — there are several variants:

• Charts — all songs available on Spotify from artists in the Master List
• Alternative — all non-pop songs
• All time — cumulative artist list by followers

You can also combine filters for more specific results.
tour.step7.title: Sections
tour.step7.text:
The chart is divided into three sections:

• Singles — individual songs
• Albums — albums and EPs
• New releases — songs released in the last 30 days

Each section can be shared separately.
tour.step8.title: Master List 📋
tour.step8.text:
This is the Master List — the main database of the site.

Here all Macedonian artists and bands are collected, along with their genres, cities, profile links and more. Practically every other function on the site (charts, news, events) depends on this list.
tour.step9.title: Search and filter
tour.step9.text:
You can search by name, genre, city or combine filters for a more precise result.

Feel free to type in Cyrillic or Latin — both work. For example, typing "rok" will show you all rock artists.
tour.step10.title: Add artist ➕
tour.step10.text:
Notice that an artist or band is missing? You can suggest them here!

Click the button, fill in the form with basic info (name, genre, links) and submit. After a quick review from our side, the artist will appear on the site.
tour.step11.title: Events 📅
tour.step11.text:
Here we collect upcoming concerts, festivals, and music events across Macedonia.

Know about an event that's not here? Click "Add event" and fill in the details. Once we verify it — we'll add it. Anyone can contribute!
tour.step12.title: News 📰
tour.step12.text:
Here you'll find news and articles about the Macedonian music scene from various online media.

The special thing is that the news isn't random — only articles that mention an artist already in the Master List are shown. This way you get only relevant news about local musicians.
tour.step13.title: Curators 🎧
tour.step13.text:
Curators are people who manually compile playlists with any kind of music and share them here.

Each curator has their own taste and style. If you also have a playlist that you keep updated — you can apply to become a curator. You don't have to be an artist, you just have to be a passionate music critic.
tour.step14.title: Surprise me 🎲
tour.step14.text:
Don't know what to listen to? No problem.

Choose a genre and time period, click the button and the site will pick a random artist for you. A great way to discover something new, or to be reminded of something forgotten.
tour.step15.title: That's all! 🎸
tour.step15.text:
Thanks for taking the tour! If you like the idea, here are a few ways you can contribute:

• Add an artist who's not in the Master List
• Add an event for an upcoming concert
• Become a curator and share your playlist
• Verify your band if you're an artist
• Say hi on Xotel Discord for ideas, feedback, or just to say hello

You can repeat the tour anytime — open ⚙ Settings and click "Site tour".

Enjoy! 🙌

about.metaDesc: Information about TopLista.mk — project, purpose, license and contact.
about.intro1: TopLista.mk is a website that automatically generates a Macedonian music chart. The site also contains an open database of Macedonian music artists and bands. The goal is to document and promote the Macedonian music scene in one place — from established names to new talents.
about.intro2: The project is powered by the Xotel community and is fully open to contributions.
about.masterList1: The Master List is a manually curated database of Macedonian music artists, stored in JSON format (bands.json). Each artist has: name, city, genre, similar artists, links to streaming platforms and social networks, contact and activity status.
about.masterList2: Adding and editing: Any visitor can suggest changes via the form on the site. When a change is submitted, it automatically goes to the GitHub repository where a pull request is opened. After manual review (currently done by Martin), the change is approved and appears on the site.
about.masterList3: Activity status: The system automatically determines the status based on the latest release — "Active" (release in the last 2 years), "Maybe" (2–3 years) or "Inactive" (over 3 years without a release).
about.criteria1: For an artist to be added to the Master List, there needs to be some proof that the artist/band actually existed — available music on streaming platforms, published news or articles, posters from performances, or the members themselves confirming the artist existed.
about.formatName: Artist name: Must be written in Cyrillic and in Macedonian, unless it doesn't make sense (for example, if the band name is in English).
about.formatCity: City: Should be the city of origin of any band member — not the city where they currently live or where the band was formed.
about.formatSoundsLike: Sounds like: Should be an obvious influence on the artist, or mentioned somewhere (interview, biography, etc.).
about.formatYouTube: YouTube: We prefer a YouTube channel instead of individual links. Links are also acceptable if no channel exists. The channel must contain only content from the artist — do not list label channels.
about.formatWikipedia: Wikipedia: The Wikipedia link must be in Macedonian (mk.wikipedia.org).
about.verify1: If you are an artist or band member already on the Master List and want to verify your profile — just click on "Verified" and choose colors for your artist, that's it. After submission, we will contact you through your official pages for verification.
about.chart1: The chart is automatically generated from data obtained via the Spotify Web API. For each artist from the Master List who has a Spotify profile, the system retrieves the latest releases (singles and albums) and checks the popularity of the songs — a metric from 0 to 100 that Spotify calculates based on recent stream counts.
about.chart2: The ranking is determined as follows:
about.chartSingles: Singles — The last 20 singles released in the past 4 weeks, sorted by Spotify popularity. Note: Spotify automatically categorizes releases with 1-4 songs as a single.
about.chartAlbums: Albums — The last 20 albums released in the past 8 weeks, sorted by the same principle
about.chartLimit: Limit per artist — Each artist can have at most 2 releases on the chart at the same time (the two most popular). This ensures greater variety on the chart.
about.chartAllTime: All time — Top 100 unique artists, sorted by Spotify follower count
about.updates1: The chart is "anchored" once a week, every Monday. This means that positions and changes (up/down arrows) are calculated by comparing current data against the snapshot from the previous Monday. Between two Mondays, data may fluctuate as Spotify updates its metrics in real time, but the official comparison is done only on a weekly basis.
about.updates2: Important: The ranking algorithms are subject to occasional changes and improvements. When a change is made to the algorithm, it may take one to two weeks for the results to fully stabilize and reflect the new logic. During that period, some positions may temporarily appear unusual.
about.popTag1: Artists who have "pop" as a genre in the Master List are not displayed in the alternative chart. This is the only filtering mechanism — if you want a certain artist not to appear in the alternative rankings, just add the genre "pop".
about.popTag2: This tag does not affect the display in the Master List or the main chart — the artist remains visible there like any other. Only the alternative chart excludes them.
about.news1: The news page aggregates content from Macedonian media sources via their RSS feeds. Sources include music-specialized portals (mono-ton, Kultura Beta, Popup Mk, MK Tickets) and general media (Sloboden Pechat, Nova Makedonija, A1on, Meta.mk, MKD.MK, Libertas, 360 Stepeni, Radio MOF, Fokus, Netpres). If you have a suggestion for a new source, join the Xotel Discord server and share your suggestion.
about.news2: Filtering: Not all news is displayed — only those that mention an artist from the Master List. The system checks the title and description of each article against artist names available in the master list. Articles that don't mention an artist from the list are discarded.
about.news3: Articles are stored in an open archive (articles.json) that is updated daily.
about.events1: Anyone can add an event to the events page, but the event must be verified following the same principle as changes to the Master List — after manual review, the event is approved and appears on the site.
about.curator1: In a world where content is increasingly generated automatically, the problem of curation becomes ever more important. Algorithms can recommend music based on numbers and trends, but nothing can replace the taste of a person who knows you — a friend, acquaintance, or someone whose taste you appreciate.
about.curator2: That's why this platform has the role of a curator — a person who manually compiles a list of songs and shares it with the community. The idea is simple: instead of an algorithm deciding what you'll listen to, let someone real recommend music to you.
about.curator3: To be a curator, one needs to be somehow involved in the music scene — whether as an artist, critic, radio show host, online blog author, or similar. This is the basic prerequisite — the goal is for curators to be people who truly know music.
about.curator4: If you want to become a curator, join the Xotel Discord server and reach out.
about.code1: If you want to contribute code or technical improvements, you're always welcome! All code is open and available on GitHub.
about.code2: About 80% of the code was written with the help of Grok and Claude, and the remaining 20% was written manually. Data is 100% manually entered and verified. Every part of the site is the result of a combination of automated tools and human effort, with a strong emphasis on accuracy and quality.
about.tech1: The site is static (HTML/CSS/JS), hosted on GitHub Pages. Data is stored in JSON format on GitHub and is open. Streaming data comes from the Spotify API.
about.license1: Artist and article data is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). You are free to use, share and adapt the data as long as you credit the source.
about.contact1: For questions, suggestions or bug reports, join the Xotel Discord server.
about.contact2: The site is currently maintained by Martin, with huge thanks to Tomi, Antonio (Matsik), Harun, Sasho, Petar, Andrej, Irena, Daniel, Mirche, Marko, Boshko, Stefan, Filip x2, the entire Xotel community and a bunch of other unsung heroes who helped in one way or another. Created with pride in the Republic of Macedonia.
